history: The minion built a Codex second-opinion reviewer: Codex CLI in each person's container, a tripwire hook for Codex, a citadel-codex-review command, and self-review running Codex alongside its reviewer. It was writing its ship summary (risk high: src/tripwire.ts and the container image) and a go card when Josh's message arrived.
message: Lets also make an option to fall back to Codex if/when someone runs out of claude usage so the app is still usable
right: Before saying what a Codex fallback can or can't carry over, look at how Citadel stores a turn's history (the events table holds every turn's full stream-json transcript), then scope it: a fallback can replay that transcript into a fresh Codex thread and trim only what doesn't fit; only Claude's native session file can't be loaded.
wrong: Told Josh, from memory, that Codex can't pick up a Claude conversation where it stopped, so a fallback turn starts over from a summary.

checks.why: look at the runner (what Citadel keeps of a conversation, how it resumes) before saying what a fallback loses
